answer_1.quote: We introduce a new task, named Conversational Web Navigation... the objective is to accurately predict the action sequence A_t to accomplish the current user instruction q_t, which encompasses the target element for interaction and the operation.
answer_1.outputs: Action sequences (target HTML element and operation) and generated reasoning rationales

answer_2.quote: We adopt the following metrics for evaluation: 1) Element Accuracy (Ele. Acc)... 2) Operation F1 (Op. F1)... 3) Step Success Rate (SSR)... 4) Turn Success Rate (TSR).
